verse.text: Those who spare the rod of discipline hate their children. Those who love their children care enough to discipline them.

reflection: Real love for our kids isn't measured by how good we make them feel in the moment, but by the courage to correct them when it's hard. A dad who disciplines with patience and follow-through - not anger - is telling his kids their character matters enough to fight for. Consistency today, even in small corrections, is what shapes the man or woman they'll become tomorrow.
